# Getting help

- **Questions, ideas and show and tell:** [Discussions](https://github.com/GitDakky/twin-me-up/discussions).
- **Bugs:** open an issue with the bug form and include the output of `twinmeup doctor`.
- **Security problems:** [report them privately](https://github.com/GitDakky/twin-me-up/security/advisories/new), never in an issue.

Before asking, the [README](https://github.com/GitDakky/twin-me-up#readme),
[integration guides](https://github.com/GitDakky/twin-me-up/blob/main/docs/integrations.md) and
`twinmeup <command> --help` answer most questions.
